visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of dark, glossy chocolate being stirred in a stainless steel bowl with a white spatula. A person’s hand holds a small square chocolate with a metallic shimmer. Two men are introduced in a professional kitchen; one is a chef in an orange apron and the other is a host in a green shirt. (2) Camera pans across various awards and certificates on a shelf. A masked employee works behind a counter in a boutique chocolate shop. A blue branded box opens to reveal neatly arranged, decorated chocolates. Back in the kitchen, the chef presents a bottle of sesame oil. (3) Close-ups show a digital thermometer measuring white milk heating in a saucepan on a stove. The hot liquid is poured into a bowl of melted chocolate. The chef uses a spatula to stir the mixture from the center, creating a swirling pattern as it emulsifies. (4) An immersion blender is used to further mix the thick chocolate ganache. Dark sesame oil is poured in from a glass bottle. The host and chef converse and laugh while the chef continues stirring. The mixture becomes extremely smooth and reflects the bright overhead kitchen lights. (5) A large, flat rectangular slab of set chocolate ganache is shown on a baking sheet. The chef uses a professional wire cutter, known as a guitar cutter, to slice the slab into long strips and then rotates it to cut uniform squares. (6) Each square is dipped into a vat of melted chocolate using a specialized metal dipping fork. The chef demonstrates a tapping technique to remove excess coating. The finished pieces are placed on a tray, showing different decorative textures on top. (7) The chef and host sit at a small marble table in a warm seating area. A bitten chocolate square is shown in an extreme close-up, revealing the soft interior. They taste the chocolates and discuss the flavors with expressive facial expressions and gestures. (8) Shots show various chocolate pastries like tarts and cakes in a brightly lit glass display case. The two men continue their conversation, appearing relaxed and happy. The host gestures towards the chef as they finish their talk. (9) A final graphic appears with a green background and geometric patterns. Logos for the show and social media platform are displayed alongside text prompts for viewers to follow the account.

The BGM remains a consistent, lighthearted electronic track. The host makes a joke, leading to a burst of natural male laughter with high valence and arousal. (4) A mechanical whirring sound of an immersion blender enters the mix for several seconds, masking the background music slightly. The chef explains the importance of emulsification with a calm, authoritative tone. No significant ambient noise is present. (5) Distinct metallic clicks and sliding sounds are heard as the wire cutter passes through the chocolate slab. The BGM tempo feels synchronized with the editing pace. The host reacts with an 'Ooh' sound, showing interest and excitement. (6) A series of rhythmic tapping sounds (percussive thuds) are audible as the chef shakes off excess chocolate from the fork. This incidental noise is sharp and well-defined. The BGM continues to provide a cheerful atmosphere throughout the process. (7) In the tasting phase, the BGM tone becomes slightly warmer. A clear, crisp crunch sound (food bite) is captured as the host bites into the chocolate. His vocal pitch rises as he describes the flavor profile, indicating positive emotion. (8) The conversation continues with frequent overlapping laughter and high-energy exchanges. The BGM swells in volume as the dialogue concludes. A final chime-like digital UI SFX plays alongside a whoosh transition as the outro graphics appear.
